name: ucc-campussphere
description: UCC CampusSphere - 3D Campus Navigation and Classroom Scheduling System

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web,admin -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start:dev -w @ucc/api" "npm run dev -w @ucc/web" "npm run dev -w @ucc/admin"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @ucc/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ucc/api && npm run build -w @ucc/web && npm run build -w @ucc/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @ucc/api && npm run typecheck -w @ucc/web && npm run typecheck -w @ucc/admin
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @ucc/api
